newsitem.title: USA: Priests robbed at St Patricks on Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Priests robbed at St Patricks on Christmas.

text.p: Robbers held up two priests at New York City's famous St. Patrick's Cathedral on Christmas and stole $175, police said on Thursday.

The two thieves followed the two priests inside the foyer of the Roman Catholic cathedral's rectory, located in midtown Manhattan behind the landmark church on Fifth Avenue, a few minutes before midnight on Wednesday, police said.
One of the men brandished a gun and announced it was a robbery, police said.
The pair stole $175 from the two priests, who were not injured. The two were not wearing clerical garments when they were robbed, police added.
The two hold-up men fled, and there have been no arrests, police said.
